entries.name: block-v3-output-tree-v4-accept#0
entries.description: A block section of version 3 holding one transaction, whose output's tree is v4 (0c 02 08 d3). Below block version 4 the JVM parses a block's transactions outside any version context (ergo BlockTransactions.scala:184-202), on a thread at the default (1, 1) (VersionContext.scala:58-61), where a tree's version is not compared with anything (:20). The section parses. Round-trip identity. The entry's version pair is nominal: the section's own block version decides the context. An impl that compares the tree's version with the block's activated version, 2, rejects the section: the over-reject. (What fails is spending such a box: the transaction vectors tree-version-above-activated.)

entries.name: block-v3-output-tree-v7-accept#1
entries.description: The same with a v7 tree (0f 02 08 d3). Below block version 4 the JVM parses a block's transactions outside any version context (ergo BlockTransactions.scala:184-202), on a thread at the default (1, 1) (VersionContext.scala:58-61), where a tree's version is not compared with anything (:20). Round-trip identity.

entries.name: block-v3-output-tree-v3-accept#2
entries.description: A block section of version 3 whose transaction's output has a v3 tree (0b 02 08 d3), above the block's activated version, 2. Below block version 4 the JVM parses a block's transactions outside any version context (ergo BlockTransactions.scala:184-202), on a thread at the default (1, 1) (VersionContext.scala:58-61), where a tree's version is not compared with anything (:20). Round-trip identity. The same transaction parsed under (2, 2) rejects (Transaction.tree_version_above_activated #0 in this directory).

entries.name: block-v3-output-tree-v4-soft-constant-degrade-accept#3
entries.description: A block section of version 3 whose transaction's output has the size-flagged, segregated v4 tree 1c 02 08 d3: 8 constants declared, the first of type code 211. Below block version 4 the JVM parses a block's transactions outside any version context (ergo BlockTransactions.scala:184-202), on a thread at the default (1, 1) (VersionContext.scala:58-61), where a tree's version is not compared with anything (:20). So the constants are read: the type code fails rule 1008 (the rule's number outside a v6 context; 1018 inside one), and the size-flagged tree degrades. Round-trip identity.

entries.name: block-v3-output-tree-v4-unsized-reject#4
entries.description: A block section of version 3 whose transaction's output has the tree header 04: version 4 without the size bit (04 08 d3). CheckHeaderSizeBit (rule 1012) does not depend on the version context: the JVM rejects. An impl that skips every header check outside a version context round-trips the section: the over-accept.
